## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for every changed rule (`pytest --cov` and `npm test` pass).
- [ ] The user manual (`docs/`) describes the new behaviour, settings, entities or services.
- [ ] The developer docs (`docs/development/`) are updated where the architecture, the control core, the stored data or the protocol changed.
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md`, including every added, renamed or removed entity.
- [ ] No secrets, private addresses or personal data in any file.
